The climate in Málaga

Málaga is about 22 m above sea level. The warmest month is July, with an average high of 31°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 9°C. Around 440 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in March (about 85 mm). The highest temperature in Málaga in 2015–2024 was 42°C (2 August 2020) and the lowest 3°C (12 January 2021).

Best time to visit Málaga

The most pleasant weather in Málaga is usually in May and October: average highs are around 24°C, with up to 6 days of rain a month. In July and August it is hot, over 30°C in the afternoon on average.
